title: 第七章 胸怀济世心，方知众生难
novel_title: 长夜君主方彻最后结局(方彻)
content_zh: 一心教中。“教主，夜魔已经进入了白云武院报到。”大供奉木林远轻声提醒。印神宫嗯了一声，并不在意。木林远道：“教主，我现在想起来，夜魔的身份……恐怕镇守者那边已经怀疑了，若是他们知会了白云武院，这样……”他叹口气：“当初，对碧波城苏家的行动，是有点冒失了。”“冒失了？”印神宫看着木林远，眼中露出奇怪的神色，有点讥讽之意：“大供奉，你认为是冒失了？你现在才想到是冒失了？”印神宫将‘现在’两个字咬的很重。“难道……”木林远怔住。印神宫闭上眼睛，淡淡的说道：“这才是夜魔真正的价值之所在！”“啊？”木林远愣住。他不明白，碧波城那件事，教派痕迹很重，导致夜魔还没有入教，就会被盯上，怎么还成了价值？印神宫闭着眼睛，声音缥缈：“白云武院这一关，包括大比，是夜魔必须要过的，而对方，也不会太难为他。若是夜魔连这一关也过不了，那么死了也就死了。”“左右也只是一个新晋教徒而已，现在他的生死，没有任何价值可言。只有他过了这关，以后，才会慢慢的展现价值。这是一条长线，首先，他首先要有成为长线的资格。木供奉，你还是适合战斗。”印神宫不说话了。木林远一直到回去自己住处，又想了半天，只感觉还是一团乱麻。似乎搞明白了，又似乎没有搞明白。“我难道真的只适合战斗？”……夜梦在勤勤恳恳打扫新家。目前来说，这个足有三进而且还有一个大园子的大院子，就只有她和方彻两个人住。夜梦自己打扫，在不动用修为的情况下，可说是很累的事情。但是她依然打扫的兴致勃勃。两岁多父母双亡的夜梦，这個大院子，还是她毕生之中拥有的第一套。虽然名字登记是方彻的，但夜梦依然有一种女主人的兴奋。前前后后的拾掇，各种家具的指挥摆放，院子的打扫，房间的安排……忙的香汗淋漓，却依然是乐此不疲。等到送货的人全走了之后，夜梦打扫完毕，看着焕然一新的院子，怔怔出神。眼神中，是说不出的喜爱。“家么？”夜梦眼中露出一丝迷离。忍不住的，心中就有一种念头升起：如果，这真的是自己的家，多好？如果自己真的是这个家的女主人，多好？她眼前泛起方彻的脸，顿时嫌弃的嘟起了嘴：这个坏蛋！随即又幽幽叹了口气。卧底到方彻身边这段时间，除了不能展露修为之外，其实还算是自己这一生之中，最舒服的一段日子。没有竞争，没有压力，没有战斗。虽然方彻经常对自己恶言恶色的，但是夜梦自己心里清楚，其实这位方公子，对自己并不坏。甚至可以说是极好！他虽然。天脉朱果改善自己资质——只是这一点，这恩情，就已经是天高地厚。这种好东西，除了父母给儿女，师父给衣钵传人之外，其他的，谁舍得给外人？但方彻就这么给自己吃了。还有那最最正统的修炼方式，各种去芜存菁的武学姿势……几乎将自己原本不对的地方全部都改正了过来！让自己战力，何止是翻了一番？甚至现在越级战斗，也是有一定把握的！还有那平常修炼的各种丹药……哪怕是在那种大宗门和各大武院之中，这些东西，都要靠抢的！而方彻就这么给自己吃了。虽然他平常冷言冷语，没啥好脸色。但是，他是真的关心自己！虽然天天喊着将自己卖入青楼，但是，这家伙估计自己都不知道青楼是干什么的吧？吓唬人也不知道换个说辞。“哎……”夜梦心里轻轻叹了口气。她心里问自己，如果有一天，上面有命令，令自己斩杀方彻。那么自己是否真的下的了手。想到这里，她死死地咬住了自己嘴唇。‘谁让你是邪教妖人啊……谁让我只是个卧底？谁让我们，有不同的信仰？’夜梦只是脆弱了很短时间，就恢复了过来。接着开始布置新家。那人脾气不好，等他回来看看还没收拾好，定要发脾气。……方彻被带走也是满心懵逼。我怎么了？我干啥了？怎么一报到就被带走了？办公大楼很是雄伟，当中是‘白云武院’这四个字。两侧是一副对联，金光闪闪。竟然是融化了黄金，用纯金烫了十个大字，每一个字，都有两丈方圆大小，气势雄浑，映照天地。上联：胸怀济世心。下联：方知众生难。落款：瑶光。很平常的两句话。但方彻猛然站住，凝目看着这两句话，只感觉脑海中如同有黄钟大吕，猛然震荡了一下。一时间，有些头晕目眩。他本能的感觉，这跟自己有关系。但无论如何想，都想不起来。他看着落款的‘瑶光’两个字，竟然挪不动脚步，只感觉胸中气血上涌，眼花缭乱。
content_en: Yixin teaches."Master, Night Demon has entered Baiyun Martial Arts Academy to report." Grand Priest Mu Linyuan reminded softly.Yinshen Palace hummed and didn't care.Mulinyuan said: "Master, now I think about it, the identity of Night Demon... I'm afraid the guardians have already suspected it. If they informed Baiyun Martial Academy, like this..." He sighed: "At the beginning, the action against the Su family in Bibo City was a bit risky.Lost it." "Is it reckless?" Yinshen Palace looked at Mu Linyuan with a strange look in his eyes, a little sarcastic: "Dad, do you think it was reckless?" Yinshen Palace emphasized the word 'now'."Could it be..." Mu Linyuan was stunned.Yinshen Palace closed his eyes and said calmly: "This is the real value of Night Demon!" "Huh?" Mu Linyuan was stunned.He didn't understand what happened in Bibo City. The traces of the sect were so strong that Night Demon would be targeted before he even joined the cult. How could he still become valuable?Yinshen Palace closed his eyes and said in a vague voice: "The level of Baiyun Martial Arts Academy, including the competition, is what Night Demon must pass, and the opponent will not make it too difficult for him. If Night Demon can't even pass this level, then he will die." "You are just a new believer.That's it, his life and death have no value at all.Only after he passes this level will he gradually show his value.This is a long-term goal.First of all, he must be qualified to become a long-term leader."Yin Shen Palace said nothing.Mulinyuan didn't think about it for a long time until he returned to his own place, but he still felt that it was still a mess.It seems to be understood, but it seems that it is not understood."Am I really only suitable for fighting?"... Ye Meng was diligently cleaning her new home.Currently, only she and Fang Che live in this large courtyard with three entrances and a large garden.Ye Meng cleans up by herself, which can be said to be very tiring work without using any cultivation skills.But she was still cleaning with great interest.In the night dream when both her parents died when she was more than two years old, this big yard was the first one she had in her life.Although the name registration belongs to Fang Che, Ye Meng still has the excitement of a hostess.Cleaning up front and back, arranging various furniture, cleaning the yard, arranging the rooms... I was so busy that I was sweating, but I still enjoyed it.After all the delivery people left, Ye Meng finished cleaning and looked at the brand-new yard, lost in thought.There was indescribable love in his eyes."Home?" Ye Meng's eyes showed a hint of confusion.Unable to help it, a thought arose in my mind: How great would it be if this was really my home?How great would it be if I really were the mistress of this family?Fang Che's face appeared in front of her eyes, and she immediately pouted in disgust: This bad guy!Then he sighed again.During the period when I was undercover with Fang Che, except that I couldn't show off my cultivation, it was actually the most comfortable period of my life.No competition, no pressure, no fighting.Although Fang Che often spoke harshly to him, Ye Meng knew in his heart that Mr. Fang was actually not bad to him.It can even be said to be excellent!He though.Tianmai Zhuguo improves his own qualifications - just this, this kind of kindness is already extremely high.Apart from parents giving this kind of good thing to their children, and master giving it to successors, who would be willing to give it to outsiders?But Fang Che just ate it for himself.There are also the most orthodox training methods, various martial arts postures that remove the bad and retain the good... almost all the things that were wrong with me have been corrected!More than doubling your combat power?Even now, there is a certain degree of certainty in leapfrogging battles!There are also the various elixirs that are usually cultivated... Even in such large sects and major martial arts academies, these things must be snatched!And Fang Che just ate it for himself.Although he usually speaks sarcastically, he doesn't have a good face.However, he really cares about himself!Although he shouts every day to sell himself into a brothel, this guy probably doesn’t even know what a brothel does, right?I don’t know how to use words to scare people."Hey..." Ye Meng sighed softly in his heart.She asked herself in her mind, if one day, there was an order from above to kill Fang Che.So did he really do it?Thinking of this, she bit her lip tightly.'Who told you to be a cult monster... Who told me to be just an undercover agent?Who made us have different beliefs?’ Ye Meng was only fragile for a short time and then recovered.Then start decorating your new home.That man has a bad temper. When he comes back and sees that he hasn't cleaned up yet, he will lose his temper....Fang Che was also confused when he was taken away.What's wrong with me?What did I do?Why was he taken away as soon as he checked in?The office building is very majestic, with the four words "Baiyun Martial Arts Academy" in it.On both sides is a pair of couplets, shining with gold.It turned out that the gold was melted, and ten large characters were stamped with pure gold. Each character was two feet in diameter, with a majestic momentum that reflected the heaven and earth.First couplet: Have a heart to help the world.Second line: Only then do we know that all living beings are in trouble.Signed: Yaoguang.Two very common sentences.But Fang Che suddenly stopped and stared at these two sentences. He felt like there was Huang Zhong Dalu in his mind, which was suddenly shaken.For a moment, I felt a little dizzy.He instinctively felt that this had something to do with him.But no matter how much I think about it, I can't remember it.He looked at the two words "Yao Guang" signed on it and couldn't move. He only felt the blood rising in his chest and was dizzy.
title_en: Chapter 7 Only when you have a heart to help the world can you realize that all living beings are in trouble
